title: Signature punching cradle
engineering: Dimensioned V-cradle and removable guide. Five 37.5 mm stations clear the 4 mm exit slit by at least 0.75 mm.
physical_check: Punch five A5 signatures through the same guide. Measure both the along-fold station offset and awl exit across the fold.

title: Short-run book nipping press
engineering: Twin hand-screw press with 10–55 mm opening. The widest opening keeps 17 mm engaged thread and 5 mm handle-to-platen clearance.
physical_check: Load a 220 mm wide cover coupon and measure four-corner gap spread under the same hand tightening sequence.

title: Sewing frame for hand-bound books
engineering: Book sewing frame with continuous anchor slot and two cord layouts. Key clearance is 1 mm per side and washer land is 4.5 mm per side.
physical_check: Sew and release a six-signature block. Measure cord movement and look for misaligned signatures.

title: Spine finishing press
engineering: Spine finishing jaws keep a continuous 245 mm working edge and 6 mm tool clearance while gripping 34 mm of block height.
physical_check: Check backing tool clearance, spine marking and clamp twist along a scrap block.

title: Fan-gluing paperback clamp
engineering: Oscillating fan-glue clamp with 16° stops each way. Replay sweeps 321 positions and measures 40.28 mm minimum base clearance.
physical_check: With a sacrificial loose-leaf block, check stop contact, glue access and leaf pull-out after curing.

title: Rotary punch offset fence
engineering: Drill-free offset fence for an assumed benchtop rotary punch. Three offsets register at 4, 8 and 12 mm across a 108 mm fixing span.
physical_check: Transfer the real tool base, lip and die center, then check repeat offsets across 20 holes in a test strip.

title: Metered leather edge dye roller
engineering: Lift-out dye roller with 2–5 mm guide settings. The roller dips 2 mm, clears the tray floor by 6 mm, and lifts 2 mm above its lip.
physical_check: Try three belt edge thicknesses and inspect coverage, leakage and cleaning access.

title: Nut and saddle thickness sander
engineering: Guided nut-and-saddle blank carrier and calibrated fence. The shortest abrasive travel across any blank point is 42 mm.
physical_check: Measure three finished blanks at both ends and the center to check thickness and taper.

title: Corner radius routing template
engineering: R12, R25 and R40 routing template layouts keep 19 mm fence overlap and 6 mm pad clearance on an assumed 62 mm wide coupon.
physical_check: Check bearing and cutter match, template seating and corner radius using test material.

title: Pottery dividing disc
engineering: Keyed centering insert and three independent tick rings at 6, 8 and 12 divisions. Radial insert play is 0.15 mm.
physical_check: Mark repeated divisions around three centered test forms and check repeat centering after removal and cleaning.

title: Manual fringe twisting head
engineering: Twin crank fringe twister with 1:1 clip rotation and two 90°-phased links. The checked link-plane gap is 6 mm.
physical_check: Twist paired thread samples and check turn counts, retaining clip damage and operating effort.

title: Knock-down warping board
engineering: Knock-down rail frame with two indexed peg recipes for 1,850.265 and 1,490.265 mm nominal yarn paths.
physical_check: Assemble three times and measure actual loop length and peg movement under normal warp tension.
